constraints.title: 单一业务事实源
constraints.rule: PostgreSQL 领域版本是正式业务权威；投影和检索可重建

constraints.title: 单一执行权威
constraints.rule: Temporal owns retry/wait/timer/recovery; no second durable checkpoint for the same task

constraints.title: 前后端分离
constraints.rule: web imports only generated contracts/SDK and UI; no DB, server, worker or model SDK imports

constraints.title: 领域边界
constraints.rule: Domain graph is acyclic; cross-domain imports target public surfaces; no cross-domain writes

constraints.title: 时间正确
constraints.rule: Evidence available_at <= cutoff; later corrections require explicit retrospective new run

constraints.title: 风险身份
constraints.rule: Full candidate before matching; IDs allocated by application; L0 target != L1 observation target

constraints.title: 四维当前状态
constraints.rule: risk_level/risk_stage/affected_scope/persistence_outlook only; change result attached to snapshot revision

constraints.title: 审批授权
constraints.rule: AI cannot self-approve; default formal decisions require authorized human review

constraints.title: 幂等交付
constraints.rule: Domain mutation + audit + Outbox atomically; Inbox and stable operation identity; no exactly-once external claim

constraints.title: 八字段关系
constraints.rule: monitored_risk_event_relation retains eight defined fields; revision/audit sidecars; first event_update_id immutable

constraints.title: 撤回强制校验
constraints.rule: All supported report reads/downloads consult authoritative status; no irrevocable public object links

constraints.title: 固定版本
constraints.rule: ExecutionManifest pins inputs, model metadata, rules, prompts, tools and worker compatibility

constraints.title: 开发隔离
constraints.rule: Worktree, branch, database, queues, object prefix and ports isolated; no production credentials

constraints.title: 组合验收
constraints.rule: Final merge candidate must pass contract, boundary and affected integration/E2E gates

constraints.title: 单一契约源
constraints.rule: JSON Schema is DTO authority; generated artifacts not edited; Ajv2020 path explicitly validated

constraints.title: 取消与提交竞争裁决
constraints.rule: Commit eligibility, execution generation, approval revision and expected result version checked with lock/CAS in the same PG transaction; signals only wake execution

constraints.title: 恢复后默认关闭
constraints.rule: Restored reports/downloads and pending commits remain closed until revocation/permission/cancellation reconciliation; stale workers fenced by recovery generation

constraints.title: 长期启动账本
constraints.rule: Stable operation identity and terminal receipt survive Temporal history retention; ambiguous missing history goes to reconciliation, never blind restart

validation_status: design checks only; runtime compatibility, security, quality, performance and recovery remain unverified
